purpose: A person's photo, or their initials on a tonal square when there is no photo.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name; the accessible name and the source of the initials

props.name: src
props.description: Photo URL; falls back to initials if it fails

whenToUse: Next to a person's name, in lists, comments and the app header
whenNotToUse: For organisations or projects — use Image
antiPatterns: Initials that do not match the name shown beside it

anatomy: A square photo, or initials on a tonal container chosen from the name
states: `color-container-*` with `color-on-container-*`, picked deterministically from the name

a11yNotes: An image named by the person: the photo's alt, or role img with aria-label for initials
The same name always gets the same colour; meaning never depends on it
